id: 15_Test Your Safety Knowledge Work At Height Scaffolding Hot Work Work Permit Syste
title: 登高、搭架、动火、办票四十问
source_doc: course/Laboratory Ergonomics & RSI/15_Test Your Safety Knowledge Work At Height Scaffolding Hot Work Work Permit Syste.md
author_source: project/Laboratory Ergonomics & RSI/15_Test Your Safety Knowledge Work At Height Scaffolding Hot Work Work Permit Syste/src.py

points.K5: 登高专用防护：全身式安全带
points.K9: 首选：能不登高就不登高
points.K40: 签发人和接收人同到现场
points.S6: 一项作业多种风险分别办票

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验楼屋顶，身后是排风机，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands on a laboratory building rooftop beside large exhaust fans and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 今天四十道题：登高、搭架、动火、办票。
overlay: 登高、搭架、动火、办票四十问

shots.scene: 四个图标：梯子、脚手架、火焰、作业票
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a ladder, a scaffold, a flame and a blank permit form. No people.
shots.narration: 四个主题，每个十道。

shots.scene: 屋顶一台旧排风机锈迹斑斑，老李在查看
shots.prompt_en: On the rooftop, the facility engineer inspects an old rusty exhaust fan connected to lab ducts.
shots.narration: 实验楼屋顶的通风柜排风机要更换。

shots.scene: 老李列出清单：登高、脚手架、切割旧支架
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer looks at a blank checklist with icons of a ladder, a scaffold and a flame.
shots.narration: 要登高、要搭架，还要切割旧支架。

shots.scene: 王老师拿着空白作业票走来，阿杰跟在后面
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator walks over with blank permit forms, followed by the young male student.
shots.narration: 王老师带阿杰来，边审批边学习。

shots.scene: 屋顶边缘、楼板孔洞、平台三个场景图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a rooftop edge, a hole in a floor and a raised platform, each with a falling arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 第一题：什么算高处作业？

shots.scene: 从高处坠向低处的箭头，孔洞闪红
shots.prompt_en: A falling arrow from an upper level to a lower level, and a floor opening flashing red. No people.
shots.narration: 有坠落到低处的风险，包括掉进孔洞。

shots.scene: 高度标尺，旁边一本书和图章
shots.prompt_en: A vertical height ruler beside a closed blank book with a stamp. No people.
shots.narration: 高度界限按国内标准，以现行文本为准。

shots.scene: 老李站在屋顶平台边，标尺显示高度
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer stands near a platform edge with a height ruler beside him.
shots.narration: 第二题：多高需要坠落防护？

shots.scene: 原题选项卡片，数字被遮住，换成国标书
shots.prompt_en: Option cards with blank number boxes are replaced by a closed standard book icon. No people.
shots.narration: 原题是国外数值，国内按国家标准。

shots.scene: 阿杰扶着额头头晕，旁边心形和闪电图标
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds his forehead dizzily; heart and lightning icons float nearby.
shots.narration: 第三题：哪些人不能登高？

shots.scene: 体检表上禁忌项打红叉
shots.prompt_en: A blank health check form with a red X on one row. No people.
shots.narration: 心脏病、癫痫等禁忌者，不能登高。

shots.scene: 没系安全带的人形图标打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person at height without a harness, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 没有坠落防护的人，同样不能上。

shots.scene: 三个危险图标：高度、无护栏边缘、碎裂的采光板
shots.prompt_en: Three hazard icons: a tall drop, an unguarded edge and a cracked skylight panel. No people.
shots.narration: 第四题：高处作业有哪些危害？

shots.scene: 采光板被踩裂的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a foot cracking through a fragile skylight panel. No people.
shots.narration: 高度、无防护的边、易碎屋面，都危险。

shots.section_title: 登高专用防护：全身式安全带
shots.scene: 安全帽、手套、反光背心、全身式安全带并排
shots.prompt_en: A safety helmet, gloves, a high-visibility vest and a full-body harness side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 第五题：登高专用的防护用品是什么？
overlay: 登高专用防护：全身式安全带

shots.section_title: 登高专用防护：全身式安全带
shots.scene: 全身式安全带、连接绳、锚点三件发光
shots.prompt_en: A full-body harness, a lanyard connector and an anchor point glow together. No people.
shots.narration: 全身式安全带，加连接件和锚固点。

shots.scene: 安全带上挂着空白检验标签
shots.prompt_en: A full-body harness with a blank inspection tag attached. No people.
shots.narration: 第六题：防坠装备多久检验一次？

shots.scene: 老李逐段检查织带和金属件
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer checks the harness webbing and metal parts section by section.
shots.narration: 原题答半年；国内按标准和说明书执行。

shots.scene: 屋顶没有锚点，一个人用手拉挂绳，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: On a roof without anchors, a person holds another's lanyard by hand; a red X appears. No people.
shots.narration: 第七题：屋顶没有固定锚点怎么办？

shots.scene: 屋顶上拉起一条水平生命线，挂钩扣上
shots.prompt_en: A horizontal lifeline is stretched across the roof and a lanyard hook clips onto it. No people.
shots.narration: 设置生命线，安全带挂在上面。

shots.scene: 老李和专业人员确认生命线固定
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer and a technician check the lifeline anchors at both ends.
shots.narration: 生命线要由专业人员安装确认。

shots.scene: 护栏特写：上横杆、中横杆、挡脚板依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a guardrail: the top rail, the mid rail and the toe-board light up in turn. No people.
shots.narration: 第八题：护栏由哪三部分组成？

shots.scene: 欣欣指着挡脚板
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at the toe-board.
shots.narration: 原题说三种系统，其实是护栏三部分。

shots.section_title: 首选：能不登高就不登高
shots.scene: 倒金字塔，顶层“避免登高”亮起
shots.prompt_en: An inverted pyramid whose top layer, showing a crossed-out ladder icon, glows green. No people.
shots.narration: 第九题：防坠落的第一选择是什么？
overlay: 首选：能不登高就不登高

shots.section_title: 首选：能不登高就不登高
shots.scene: 排风机滤网改到地面可更换的位置
shots.prompt_en: An exhaust filter housing is relocated to a spot reachable from the ground. No people.
shots.narration: 能在地面完成的，就不要上高处。

shots.section_title: 首选：能不登高就不登高
shots.scene: 护栏、生命线、安全带依次排在后面
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a guardrail, a lifeline and a harness line up below the top layer. No people.
shots.narration: 做不到再用护栏，最后靠安全带。

shots.scene: 平台边缘一把扳手掉下
shots.prompt_en: A wrench slides off the edge of a raised platform. No people.
shots.narration: 第十题：怎么防止东西从高处掉下？

shots.scene: 挡脚板、捆好的材料、系绳工具和工具袋
shots.prompt_en: A toe-board, tied-down materials, a tool with a wrist strap and a tool bag, each with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 设挡脚板，固定材料，工具系绳装袋。

shots.scene: 脚手架图标：踏板滑脱、坠物、缺护栏三处闪红
shots.prompt_en: A scaffold icon with three red spots: a sliding plank, a falling object and a missing guardrail. No people.
shots.narration: 进入脚手架：事故主要因为什么？

shots.scene: 欣欣举起三个勾
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a card with three check marks.
shots.narration: 踏板支撑失效、滑倒被砸、护栏缺损。

shots.scene: 阿杰在架子下仰头检查
shots.prompt_en: The young male student looks up carefully at a rooftop scaffold before climbing.
shots.narration: 上架前谁来检查？你自己先查。

shots.scene: 绿色合格牌挂在架子上
shots.prompt_en: A green inspection tag hangs on the scaffold. No people.
shots.narration: 搭设方验收挂牌，也缺一不可。

shots.scene: 踩交叉支撑爬架的图标打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person climbing cross braces, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 能踩交叉支撑上去吗？不能。

shots.scene: 老李走专用爬梯上架
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer climbs the scaffold's built-in access ladder.
shots.narration: 要走专用爬梯。

shots.scene: 断裂踏板换成专用踏板
shots.prompt_en: A cracked plank is replaced with a proper scaffold plank. No people.
shots.narration: 踏板坏了，只能用专用踏板换。

shots.scene: 普通木板被压弯的图标打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an ordinary board bending under weight, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 随手找的木板，承重不够。

shots.scene: 踏板间的缝隙合拢
shots.prompt_en: The gap between two scaffold planks closes tightly. No people.
shots.narration: 踏板缝要小，防踩空和落物。

shots.scene: 小扳手从缝里掉下的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a small wrench dropping through a gap between planks. No people.
shots.narration: 缝大了会踩空，也会漏下工具。

shots.scene: 两块踏板在横杆上搭接足够长
shots.prompt_en: Two planks overlap generously over a support bar. No people.
shots.narration: 搭接要够长，数值按国内规范。

shots.scene: 架上人员有护栏和安全带
shots.prompt_en: A worker icon on a scaffold platform is protected by guardrails and a harness. No people.
shots.narration: 高处作业，人人都要有坠落防护。

shots.scene: 高度标尺和国标书图标
shots.prompt_en: A height ruler beside a closed blank standard book. No people.
shots.narration: 高度界限按国内标准执行。

shots.scene: 挂钩挂在架子上，架子倾倒，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: A lanyard hook on a tipping scaffold, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 安全带不随便挂在架子上，

shots.scene: 挂钩挂在独立牢固锚点上
shots.prompt_en: A lanyard hook on an independent strong anchor point with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 要挂在独立、牢固的锚点上。

shots.scene: 电线碰到架子，人形触电图标
shots.prompt_en: A power line touches the scaffold and a person icon is shocked. No people.
shots.narration: 有人触电怎么办？别徒手拉。

shots.scene: 断开电源和电话120图标
shots.prompt_en: A power switch turned off and a telephone icon with a medical cross. No people.
shots.narration: 先断电，再拨打120。

shots.scene: 梯子旁的警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A warning triangle beside a stepladder. No people.
shots.narration: 梯子摔下，同样可能致命。

shots.scene: 小研扶梯，阿杰站在梯子中段
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student steadies a stepladder while the young male student stands on a middle step.
shots.narration: 梯子不高也要有人扶、站得稳。

shots.scene: 割炬到气瓶的气路上装着回火防止器
shots.prompt_en: A flashback arrester fitted on the hose between a cutting torch and a gas cylinder. No people.
shots.narration: 进入动火：防回火靠回火防止器。

shots.scene: 火焰箭头倒窜被挡住的图标
shots.prompt_en: A red flame arrow running back along a hose is stopped at the arrester. No people.
shots.narration: 挡住火焰倒窜进软管和气瓶。

shots.scene: 气瓶直立并用链条固定
shots.prompt_en: Gas cylinders standing upright and chained. No people.
shots.narration: 气瓶直立放置，固定牢靠。

shots.scene: 横躺滚动的气瓶打红叉
shots.prompt_en: A cylinder lying on its side and rolling, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 横放会滚动，容易碰坏瓶阀。

shots.scene: 机器转速表低于砂轮额定转速表
shots.prompt_en: A machine speed dial reads below the grinding wheel's rated speed dial. No people.
shots.narration: 机器转速不超过砂轮允许转速。

shots.scene: 砂轮碎裂飞出的图标打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a shattering grinding wheel, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 超速转动，砂轮会碎裂飞出。

shots.scene: 瓶帽扳手、肥皂水查漏、回火防止器三图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a cylinder cap and wrench, soapy bubbles on a hose joint and a flashback arrester. No people.
shots.narration: 气瓶用前查扳手、查漏、查防回火。

shots.scene: 明火试漏图标打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a lighter flame near a hose joint, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 绝不能用明火试漏。

shots.scene: 小木锤轻敲悬挂的砂轮
shots.prompt_en: A small wooden mallet taps a hanging grinding wheel. No people.
shots.narration: 砂轮装前敲一敲，声音发闷就报废。

shots.scene: 有裂纹的砂轮放进报废箱
shots.prompt_en: A cracked grinding wheel is dropped into a scrap box. No people.
shots.narration: 有裂纹的砂轮，立即报废。

shots.scene: 电钻：双重绝缘、松手即停、完好电缆
shots.prompt_en: A power drill with icons for double insulation, a release-to-stop trigger and an intact cable. No people.
shots.narration: 电动工具：双重绝缘、松手即停、线完好。

shots.scene: 破皮电缆打红叉
shots.prompt_en: A power cable with damaged insulation, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 电缆破皮，立即停用。

shots.scene: 阴凉通风的气瓶间，远离溶剂桶和焊接点
shots.prompt_en: A cool ventilated cylinder store, far from solvent drums and a welding area. No people.
shots.narration: 气瓶存阴凉通风处，远离可燃物和动火点。

shots.scene: 太阳暴晒气瓶的图标打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of the sun beating down on a cylinder, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 受热会升压，所以要阴凉。

shots.scene: 焊机回路线夹在工件旁
shots.prompt_en: A welding return cable clamped right next to the workpiece. No people.
shots.narration: 焊机回路线，接在离工件最近处。

shots.scene: 回路线夹在远处管道上，电流绕远路，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: A return cable clamped on a distant pipe with a long winding current arrow, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 接远了电流乱走，会打火伤人。

shots.scene: 气瓶泄压装置放出一股气
shots.prompt_en: A cylinder pressure relief device releases a puff of gas. No people.
shots.narration: 泄压装置在超压、过热时放气。

shots.scene: 泄压装置旁禁止触碰图标
shots.prompt_en: A do-not-touch pictogram beside the relief device. No people.
shots.narration: 泄压装置不许随意拆改。

shots.scene: 强光、火花、烟雾三图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a bright arc light, flying sparks and a gray fume cloud. No people.
shots.narration: 焊接有强光、火花、有毒烟尘。

shots.scene: 焊接区设排风和屏风
shots.prompt_en: A welding area with a local exhaust hood and a welding screen. No people.
shots.narration: 开排风、设屏挡、戴好防护。

shots.scene: 王老师举起空白作业票
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator holds up a blank work permit form on the rooftop.
shots.narration: 进入作业许可：它管住危险作业，

shots.scene: 措施清单逐项打勾
shots.prompt_en: Items on a blank checklist get green checks one by one. No people.
shots.narration: 让措施落实，安全完成工作。

shots.scene: 作业票中间的盾牌栏
shots.prompt_en: A blank permit form with a shield icon in the middle section. No people.
shots.narration: 票上写的，是控制风险必须做的措施。

shots.scene: 法规书和通用清单打叉
shots.prompt_en: A law book and a generic checklist crossed out with red X marks. No people.
shots.narration: 不是照抄条文，而是针对这项活。

shots.scene: 扫帚卡片绿色，火焰卡片红色
shots.prompt_en: A green card with a broom icon and a red card with a flame icon. No people.
shots.narration: 日常清扫风险低，可以不办票。

shots.scene: 射线、火焰、压力管道卡片亮红
shots.prompt_en: Radiation, flame and pressure pipe cards glow red. No people.
shots.narration: 射线、动火、压力试验，都要办。

shots.scene: 盾牌卡片放大，档案盒淡出
shots.prompt_en: A shield card grows while a file box card fades. No people.
shots.narration: 办票的目的是防事故，不是留档案。

shots.scene: 事故图标被盾牌挡住
shots.prompt_en: An accident icon is blocked by a shield. No people.
shots.narration: 把风险挡在动手之前。

shots.scene: 接收人签字、措施落实、看火人三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a signature, a checked list and a person holding an extinguisher. No people.
shots.narration: 签发动火票前：查签字、查措施、查看火人。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿灭火器站在一旁
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands nearby holding a fire extinguisher.
shots.narration: 三样都到位，才签发。

shots.scene: 王老师和老李在屋顶现场比划
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator and the facility engineer discuss on the rooftop, pointing at the fan.
shots.narration: 联合检查谈清：干什么、用什么、有何特殊。

shots.scene: 通风柜残留试剂的图标闪烁
shots.prompt_en: Icons of leftover reagent bottles in a fume hood flash yellow. No people.
shots.narration: 比如排风管里可能有化学残留。

shots.scene: 易燃液体泵房图标亮红，实验室图标加门禁锁
shots.prompt_en: A pump room with flammable drums glows red, and a laboratory icon gets an access lock. No people.
shots.narration: 原题受限区域是易燃物料泵区，

shots.scene: 老周开门让老李进实验室
shots.prompt_en: The older man opens a lab door for the facility engineer after checking the permit.
shots.narration: 危化品实验室，国内也实行准入。

shots.scene: 时钟、硬币卡片打叉，低风险卡片打勾
shots.prompt_en: Clock and coin cards crossed out, a low-risk card with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 只有低风险能免办，时间短不算理由。

shots.scene: 欣欣摇手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot wags a finger.
shots.narration: 图省事、图便宜，都不能免办。

shots.scene: 撕开的作业票、警铃、暴风雨图标
shots.prompt_en: A torn permit, an alarm bell and a storm icon. No people.
shots.narration: 违反条件、紧急情况、天气恶劣，取消许可。

shots.scene: 王老师举手叫停作业
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator raises a hand to stop the work.
shots.narration: 发现问题，立即叫停。

shots.section_title: 签发人和接收人同到现场
shots.scene: 王老师和老李一起在作业票上签字
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator and the facility engineer each sign the permit on site.
shots.narration: 签发人和接收人，一起到现场检查。
overlay: 签发人和接收人同到现场

shots.section_title: 签发人和接收人同到现场
shots.scene: 两个图标同走向现场
shots.prompt_en: Two person icons, one with a pen and one with a toolbox, walk to the site together. No people.
shots.narration: 看过同一个现场，再分别签字。

shots.scene: 屋顶边缘装着护栏，楼板孔洞盖着盖板
shots.prompt_en: A rooftop edge with a guardrail and a floor opening covered by a secured cover plate. No people.
shots.narration: 屋面边缘、楼板洞口，先做好防护。

shots.scene: 洞口盖板被挪开无人看管，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An open floor hole with its cover removed and no barrier, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 盖板挪开要有人看守、设围挡。

shots.scene: 警戒线围住作业区下方
shots.prompt_en: Barrier tape and warning signs mark off the area below the work zone. No people.
shots.narration: 下方设警戒区，无关人员绕行。

shots.scene: 屋顶排风机出口冒出淡淡的气流
shots.prompt_en: A faint stream of exhaust comes out of a rooftop fume hood exhaust stack. No people.
shots.narration: 排风机排出的是实验室废气。

shots.scene: 王老师通知各实验室暂停使用通风柜
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator posts a blank notice on a lab door and talks to the older man.
shots.narration: 检修前通知实验室停用通风柜。

shots.scene: 排风机断电上锁挂牌
shots.prompt_en: The exhaust fan's switch is locked out with a padlock and a blank tag. No people.
shots.narration: 排风机断电上锁，防止突然启动。

shots.scene: 老李戴防护口罩和手套拆风机
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer wears a respirator and gloves while removing the fan housing.
shots.narration: 拆风管戴好防护，内壁可能有残留。

shots.scene: 架上有人干活，下方有人同时作业，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of one worker on a scaffold above another working directly below, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 上下两层，不能同时交叉作业。

shots.scene: 设置隔离防护棚，或错开时间
shots.prompt_en: A protective canopy is set up over the lower area, beside a clock showing staggered times. No people.
shots.narration: 必须同时，要设隔离防护，专人协调。

shots.scene: 高处切割时火花向下飞溅
shots.prompt_en: Sparks from cutting on a raised platform shower downward. No people.
shots.narration: 高处动火，火花会往下落。

shots.scene: 下方铺防火毯，接火盆接住火花
shots.prompt_en: A fire blanket is spread below and a spark catch tray collects the sparks. No people.
shots.narration: 下方铺防火毯，用接火盆接住。

shots.scene: 阿杰在下方看火，手拿灭火器
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands below as fire watch, holding a fire extinguisher.
shots.narration: 上下都要有人看火。

shots.scene: 老李一手扛着风机部件一手爬梯，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person climbing a ladder with one hand while carrying a heavy part on the shoulder, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 别扛着重物爬梯子。

shots.scene: 用绳索和滑轮把部件吊上屋顶
shots.prompt_en: A part is lifted to the rooftop with a rope and pulley while the facility engineer guides it.
shots.narration: 材料用吊运，人空手三点着梯。

shots.scene: 两人配合抬风机，膝盖弯曲背挺直
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer and the young male student lift a fan unit together with bent knees and straight backs.
shots.narration: 重部件两人抬，屈膝挺背不扭腰。

shots.section_title: 一项作业多种风险分别办票
shots.scene: 三张作业票：高处、动火、临时用电
shots.prompt_en: Three blank permit forms with icons of a ladder, a flame and a plug. No people.
shots.narration: 一项工程涉及几种特殊作业，
overlay: 一项作业多种风险分别办票

shots.section_title: 一项作业多种风险分别办票
shots.scene: 王老师把三张票逐一核对签字
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator checks and signs each of the three permits.
shots.narration: 就分别办票，措施分别落实。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在白板前，四个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at a whiteboard with icons of a ladder, a scaffold, a flame and a permit.
shots.narration: 能不登高就不登高，登高必须防坠落。

shots.scene: 护栏、挡脚板、生命线图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a guardrail, a toe-board and a lifeline. No people.
shots.narration: 护栏三件套，锚点要可靠。

shots.scene: 合格牌、爬梯、断电图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a green tag, an access ladder and a power switch. No people.
shots.narration: 脚手架验收挂牌，触电先断电。

shots.scene: 气瓶、砂轮、接火盆图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an upright cylinder, a grinding wheel and a spark tray. No people.
shots.narration: 气瓶直立防回火，高处动火接火花。

shots.scene: 作业票和握手图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a permit form and a handshake. No people.
shots.narration: 危险作业先办票，双方同到现场。

shots.scene: 欣欣在新装好的排风机旁挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye beside a newly installed rooftop exhaust fan.
shots.narration: 步步有防护，高处也安心！
